title: Mamluks capture Acre, the last crusader stronghold
summary: The Mamluk army of Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil stormed Acre after a six-week siege. The remaining crusader towns on the coast were abandoned soon after.
reason: The Mamluks were driving the last Latin Christians from the Levant, and a massacre of Muslims in Acre gave them a pretext.
significance: It ended the crusader states in the Holy Land.
